summary: Revision 4 retains the authorized five-family scope, accepted Button variants, source-first design-spec review and handoff before Figma work, and later Light/Dark visual judgment. The registered hashes match the current plan, contract, and source documents. The selected NavigationItem contract now specifies 700 versus default 500 weight, a meaningful persistent non-color cue. Dark hover resolves to canvas #171717 and dark selected to surface.subtle #3d3d3d, on opposite sides of the previously reported #262626 parent surface; actual perceptual distinction still requires the planned comparison on the real Figma parent. One contradictory per-variant source instruction can lead the Figma projection back to the ineffective medium-weight cue and must be reconciled before the design-spec handoff.

open_findings.finding: The NavigationItem default, hover, and focus entries in docs/design/components.json still say selected/current uses a medium-weight label and set visual.selectedCue to medium-weight-label, while the selected entry and componentContracts.NavigationItem specify 700 against default 500. A consumer of the per-variant entries could preserve the already ineffective 500-weight cue.
open_findings.required_correction: Reconcile those three per-variant behavior and selectedCue fields with the 700-weight selected contract, register the changed source hashes, and obtain fresh plan and design-spec reviews before Figma projection. Capture the actual dark navigation parent fill when comparing default, hover, and selected in the planned Light/Dark visual check.
